correctness.rationale: For positive telegraph switch rate, every finite switching history has positive support probability; rapid alternating controls approximate any bounded measurable forcing in the variation-of-constants integral, so the fixed-horizon support equals the planar zonoid b∫[0,T] e^{As}e2 u(s) ds with |u|<=1 and no dependence on switching rate. The zonotope area formula 4Σ_{i<j}|det(w_i,w_j)| yields A(T)=4b²/δ∫_0^T(1-e^{-δ(T-u)})|h(u)|du using det(g(s),g(t))=-e^{-δs}h(t-s). Twice differentiating gives A''+δA'=4b²|h(T)|. In the underdamped case h=e^{-αt}sin(ωt)/ω, its simple zeros yield jump 8b²e^{-αnπ/ω} in the third derivative, and spacing, ratio, amplitude recover ω, α and b, not λ. Overdamped and critical h>0 for T>0 are analytic. Independent N=750 double-determinant zonotope and convolution quadratures agreed with 4.5e-6 relative error; this is supplementary numerical corroboration.
